partners.mechanism_chain: TAFAZZIN (HGNC:11478) —DISRUPTS→ Cardiolipin biosynthesis (REACT:R-HSA-193951); Cardiolipin biosynthesis (REACT:R-HSA-193951) —LEADS_TO→ Barth syndrome (MONDO:0010543); HSPD1 (HGNC:5455) —DISRUPTS→ Mitochondrial protein folding (GO:0006457); Mitochondrial protein folding (GO:0006457) —LEADS_TO→ Hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 4 (MONDO:0012824); Cardiolipin biosynthesis (REACT:R-HSA-193951) —BINDS→ Mitochondrial protein folding (GO:0006457). Loss-of-function mutations in TAFAZZIN disrupt cardiolipin biosynthesis, leading to Barth syndrome. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in HSPD1 impair mitochondrial protein folding, causing hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 4.
